concerns: The LLM-judge used for headline outcomes is also used as an LLM backbone in the evaluated systems, so the reported gains are not shown to be independent of the evaluation signal.
The evaluator-independent F1 measurements do not consistently corroborate the headline LLM-judge improvements; in several settings F1 decreases or remains mixed relative to baselines.
The paper does not report evaluator calibration, inter-rater agreement against independent labels, or a separately calibrated judge, leaving independence of the headline metric unestablished.
scholarly_quality.concise_summary: The paper provides an innovative yet rigorous architecture, clear formalization, thorough empirical validation across benchmarks and LLM backbones, and detailed complexity and ablation studies justifying its architectural design.

represents long-
term memory as executable code and retrieves information through query-specific programs. The
framework comprises two components: (1)codified constructiontransforms facts extracted from in-
teraction histories into a three-level executable memory structure. The atomic function layer encodes
facts as functions with canonical identifiers and source references; the relational layer connects fact
functions through explicit supersession relations while retaining historical evidence; and the modu-
lar composition layer composes base functions into reusable current-state and history computations.
A compact memory index exposes function capabilities, arguments, and available operators for re-

evidence.excerpt:
(MaC), a framework that uses a
shared code abstraction to connect memory capabilities with query-specific composition.
• We develop two complementary techniques:codified constructionorganizes facts, their
evolving relations, and reusable computations in a three-level executable memory structure
with consistent state semantics and source provenance;declarative retrievalcompiles each
query into a complete retrieval program that selects and composes these capabilities in one
LLM planning call.
2
• Extensive experiments on widely used memory benchmarks show that MaC achieves the
highest overall LLM-judge accuracy in all four evaluation settings, improving over the
strongest baseline by up to 15.91% on LOCOMOand 9.06% on LONGMEMEVAL. Abla-
tion studies further support the benefits of both techniques.

ryOS (Kang et al., 2025), Mem0 (Chhikara et al., 2025), and MRAgent Ji et al. (2026).

DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On LONGMEMEVAL, we use Qwen3.6-27B as the backbone for all methods.
Following prior work, we report F1 and LLM-Judge (J) scores. LLM-Judge (J) scores are obtained
using DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Our code is available at:https://github.com/zengaoting/

evidence.excerpt:
We report construction and query-processing costs separately on LOCOMOin Figure 3, and their
combined per-sample costs on LONGMEMEVALin Table 3.
Token consumption.Figure 3(a) shows that MaC requires the fewest tokens for memory con-
struction across all three backbones on LOCOMO. This demonstrates that building an executable

blocking_reasons: The LLM-judge used for headline outcomes is also used as an LLM backbone in the evaluated systems, so the reported gains are not shown to be independent of the evaluation signal.
The evaluator-independent F1 measurements do not consistently corroborate the headline LLM-judge improvements; in several settings F1 decreases or remains mixed relative to baselines.
The paper does not report evaluator calibration, inter-rater agreement against independent labels, or a separately calibrated judge, leaving independence of the headline metric unestablished.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Token-level F1 scores are reported alongside the LLM-judge metric, but they move inconsistently with the headline LLM-judge gains, with MaC not clearly best on several F1 dimensions.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Headline accuracy is established by an LLM judge, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, over the benchmark question sets.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: No training or tuning against the judge is reported; construction, planning, and answer generation rely on prompt-guided LLM inference with heuristic repair routines.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Reported gains (up to 15.91% higher LLM-judge accuracy on LOCOMO and 9.06% on LONGMEMEVAL, with substantial token reductions) are directly corroborated by empirical results in Tables 1-4 and ablation studies.
primary.evaluation_assessment: MaC is systematically evaluated on LOCOMO and LONGMEMEVAL across three backbone models, measuring both standard F1 and LLM-Judge accuracy against four recent baselines, supplemented by comprehensive token consumption, latency, storage, and ablation analyses.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: In addition to LLM-judge metrics, the authors report standard token-level F1 scores and exact evidence-matching evaluations across tasks and models.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Headline evaluation is performed using external benchmark test sets (LOCOMO, LONGMEMEVAL) assessed via token-level F1 and an independent LLM judge (DeepSeek-V4-Flash).
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The memory construction and retrieval programs are generated via prompt-guided LLM inference and heuristic schema validation without training or fine-tuning against the evaluation judge.

primary.limitations: The work relies on an LLM for structured fact extraction and query planning, requiring validation checks and bounded repair routines when generated code fails or encounters unresolved states.
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed, specifying atomic fact extraction, supersession relation tracking, derived compositional templates, memory indexing, and query translation into executable programs with formal algorithmic specifications and complexity analysis.
primary.quality_rationale: The paper provides an innovative yet rigorous architecture, clear formalization, thorough empirical validation across benchmarks and LLM backbones, and detailed complexity and ablation studies justifying its architectural design.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces Memory as Code (MaC), a framework for long-term agent memory that pairs a three-layer executable code representation of dialogue history with declarative single-turn program planning and sandboxed execution for retrieval.

scholarly_quality.rationale: The paper provides an innovative yet rigorous architecture, clear formalization, thorough empirical validation across benchmarks and LLM backbones, and detailed complexity and ablation studies justifying its architectural design.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The work relies on an LLM for structured fact extraction and query planning, requiring validation checks and bounded repair routines when generated code fails or encounters unresolved states.

limitations_or_uncertainty.value: Structured research-card claims use title, abstract/summary, metadata, screening rules, and curation. A separate scholarly-quality assessment used bounded full-text excerpts, but unsupported claim, method, or evidence fields remain unextracted.
